content:
Apple TV has unveiled the trailer for Nocturne, a brand-new thriller series adapted from Lars Kepler's bestselling crime novel The Sandman.

Nocturne is a brand-new thriller series premiering on October 30.

Apple TV's library features plenty of gripping crime thrillers, and they plan to add several more this autumn.

One of them—Nocturne—is adapted from Lars Kepler's bestselling novel The Sandman.

Nocturne will premiere on Friday, October 30, with its first two episodes, followed by new episodes every Sunday until December 25.

The story revolves around a serial killer and stars Liev Schreiber and Zazie Beetz, with Stephen Graham—known for Adolescence—playing the killer.

Apple has just released the trailer, giving everyone a first glimpse of this chilling new series. Below is the official synopsis for Nocturne, followed by the trailer.

Two weeks before Nocturne airs, another crime thriller, 12 12 12, will premiere on Apple TV. The series stars Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan, centring on a heist and unfolding over 12 months of planning, 12 hours of action, and the 12 days that follow.

Looking beyond autumn, Apple plans to kick off 2027 with the major thriller The Wanted Man, starring Hugh Laurie as a major organised crime figure.

Are you planning to watch Nocturne when it premieres next month? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, or you can save with a bundle through the Apple One plan.
